paper_title: New Constraints on ALP Electron and Photon Couplings from ArgoNeuT and the MiniBooNE Beam Dump
notes: Paper sets new constraints on both ALP-photon (g_agamma) and ALP-electron (g_ae) couplings from MiniBooNE dump mode at 2 sigma C.L. Pre-analysis hint and the more novel/competitive result lean toward AxionElectron (Fig. 8, g_ae vs m_a). The paper equally presents an AxionPhoton (g_agamma) limit in Fig. 7. Data points are approximate reads from the exclusion contour in Fig. 8 (only an exclusion plot is given, no table). Mass range ~10 keV to ~50 MeV. The undulating resonant feature near 10 MeV makes precise reading difficult. ArgoNeuT curves are projections; the reported limit is the MiniBooNE observed exclusion. Confidence reduced because two coupling types are presented and data is read from plot.
